name: Dixyrazine
summary: Dixyrazine, also known as dixypazin (oxalate), sold under the brand names Ansiolene, Esocalm, Esucos, Metronal, and Roscal, is a typical antipsychotic of the phenothiazine group described as a neuroleptic and antihistamine. It was first introduced in Germany in 1969.5 and 75 mg a day.

uses.text: Dixyrazine, also known as dixypazin (oxalate), sold under the brand names Ansiolene, Esocalm, Esucos, Metronal, and Roscal, is a typical antipsychotic of the phenothiazine group described as a neuroleptic and antihistamine.

pharmacology.en: Like other typical antipsychotics, it blocks dopamine D2 receptors. It also blocks histamine H1 receptors, which adds to its sedating effect.
pharmacology.zh: 與其他典型抗精神病藥一樣，它會阻斷多巴胺D2受體。它也會阻斷組織胺H1受體，使鎮靜效果更明顯。
pharmacology.zhHans: 与其他典型抗精神病药一样，它会阻断多巴胺D2受体。它也会阻断组织胺H1受体，使镇静效果更明显。

sideEffects.en: As with other phenothiazines, it can cause drowsiness, dry mouth, dizziness on standing, and movement problems such as stiffness, tremor and restlessness. Long-term use can lead to tardive dyskinesia, and the rare neuroleptic malignant syndrome is a medical emergency.
sideEffects.zh: 與其他啡噻𠯤類藥物一樣，它可能造成嗜睡、口乾、起身時頭暈，以及僵硬、顫抖與坐立不安等動作問題。長期使用可能導致遲發性運動障礙，而罕見的抗精神病藥惡性症候群屬於醫療急症。
sideEffects.zhHans: 与其他啡噻𠯤类药物一样，它可能造成嗜睡、口干、起身时头晕，以及僵硬、颤抖与坐立不安等动作问题。长期使用可能导致迟发性运动障碍，而罕见的抗精神病药恶性症候群属于医疗急症。

fact.en: It is a phenothiazine, the same three-ring family as chlorpromazine, the first antipsychotic, whose chemistry grew out of research on dyes and antihistamines.
fact.zh: 它屬於啡噻𠯤類，與第一種抗精神病藥氯丙嗪同屬三環家族，而這類化學結構源自染料與抗組織胺的研究。
fact.zhHans: 它属于啡噻𠯤类，与第一种抗精神病药氯丙嗪同属三环家族，而这类化学结构源自染料与抗组织胺的研究。
